name: gitlab
description: Interact with GitLab repositories, issues, merge requests, and code. Supports file operations, branch management, and project management through the GitLab API.

GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: GitLab personal access token with api scope. Generate one at https://gitlab.com/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens.

GITLAB_API_URL.description: GitLab API base URL. Defaults to https://gitlab.com/api/v4. Set this for self-hosted GitLab instances.
